_meta.purpose: Declared roster of every sgs* editor-extension attribute: which blocks receive it (opt-in rule), its shape, and the CSS its PHP emitter produces. Read by sgs-update-v2.py::_seed_extension_attr_rows, which writes block_attributes rows with source='sgs-ext'. scripts/check-extension-roster.js fails the build when this file drifts from the extension JS attribute names or from check-universal-fit.js's per-block gating.

rule_modes.allowlist: block lists `enabledSlug` in supports.sgs.enabledExtensions (and, when `requiresClassName`, does not set supports.className=false)
rule_modes.universal: every block unless supports.className=false (when `requiresClassName`) or supports.sgs.hideExtensions lists `hideSlug`
rule_modes.denylist: every sgs/* block unless supports.sgs.hideExtensions lists `hideSlug` (core blocks named in `coreBlocks` also receive it in the editor but have no sgs-owned DB rows)
rule_modes.named: only the blocks named in `blocks`; none of them is an sgs/* block, so no rows are seeded unless the rule sets `seedRows` (then the seeder adds a blocks row for each named block and an sgs-ext row for each attribute)

_meta.fields: type, default (omitted = no default), enum, tier_shape, is_responsive, role (an existing roles.role_name), css_property/css_element/css_state/css_tier (omitted = NULL: no single CSS property to route, or a discovered enum), requires (companion attributes a calibration marker must also carry before the setting paints anything)
_meta.canvas_source: An extension entry may set canvasSource: "rest" when its editor canvas is drawn from a server route its editor component fetches (no editor.BlockListBlock read). scripts/wiring-fingerprint/wf_extensions.py then counts a sgs/v1 route named in the entry's files as the canvas read of every attribute of the entry.
_meta.css_slots: db-consistency check_routing allows one attribute per (css_property, css_element, css_state, css_tier) on a block, so a CSS slot is declared once. Controls that paint a slot a block can already own (width) keep css_property NULL.
_meta.css_element: wrapper = the block root; image = the img/video inside it (assets/css/extensions.css .sgs-has-image-controls rules)

extensions._comment: Text by time of day (Spec 02 FR-2-14): hour ranges, each with its own words, swapped in the visitor's browser by includes/time-text.php's @sgs/time-text module. supports.sgs.timeTextWords names the attribute holding the block's words (the server fallback).

The blockLink extension's URL field asks an operator to TYPE the destination. A block that already knows its own destination at render time (a product card links to the product it renders; a logo links to the site home) declares supports.sgs.blockLinkAutoUrl, which replaces that URL field with this single toggle and lets the block hand the URL over from render.php via includes/helpers-stretched-link.php::sgs_stretched_link_handover. One control per capability: the URL field and this toggle are never both live.

Shop look settings on WooCommerce's Cart and Checkout blocks (Spec 27 FR-30-18). No attribute carries a default: absent is WooCommerce's and the theme's own look. seedRows makes the seeder write block_attributes rows (and a blocks row) for these two non-sgs blocks so the cloning route finds the settings.
